learning_objective: 到达或离开时,孩子能主动完成一次问候或告别(说“你好”或挥手说“再见,明天见”),在提示下 3 次中≥2 次达成。
intro_zh: 见到好朋友的时候,我可以先看着对方,微笑挥手说“你好”;要走的时候,我挥挥手说“再见,明天见”。今天我们一起来练习打招呼和道别。
intro_en: When I see my good friend, I can look at them, smile, and wave to say hello; when it is time to go, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow. Today we practice greeting and saying goodbye.

steps.text_zh: 见到朋友,我先看着对方。
steps.text_en: When I see my friend, I look at them first.
steps.narration_zh: 见到朋友的时候,我先看着对方,让他知道我看见他了。
steps.narration_en: When I see my friend, I look at them first so they know I noticed them.

steps.text_en: I smile and wave to say hello.
steps.narration_zh: 我对朋友微笑,挥一挥手,说一声“你好”。
steps.narration_en: I smile at my friend, wave my hand, and say hello.

steps.text_zh: 要走时,我挥手说“再见,明天见”。
steps.text_en: When I leave, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow.
steps.narration_zh: 要走的时候,我挥挥手,对朋友说“再见,明天见”。
steps.narration_en: When it is time to go, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow.

steps.text_zh: 朋友也向我挥手,大家都很友好。
steps.text_en: My friend waves back, and we are all friendly.
steps.narration_zh: 朋友也向我挥挥手回应我,我们都觉得很友好、很开心。
steps.narration_en: My friend waves back to me, and we both feel friendly and happy.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 早上你到了,看见好朋友。轮到你,试着打个招呼。
practice_trials.prompt_en: You arrive in the morning and see your good friend. Your turn — give a greeting a try.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你主动打招呼说“你好”,真友好!
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You said hello all by yourself. So friendly!

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 说“你好”的时候,你的身体还可以怎么做呢?
practice_trials.prompt_en: When you say hello, what can your body do too?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我看着朋友,微笑挥挥手。
practice_trials.answer_en: I look at my friend, smile, and wave.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你会看着对方、微笑挥手,打招呼更亲切了!
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You looked, smiled, and waved. Your greeting felt warm!

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 玩好了要回家,该和朋友道别。轮到你,试试看。
practice_trials.prompt_en: Playtime is over and it is time to go home. Your turn — say goodbye to your friend.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你挥手说“再见,明天见”,告别得真好!
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You waved and said goodbye, see you tomorrow. Great job!

social_choice.scenario_zh: 你到了,看见好朋友……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: You arrive and see your good friend... what can you do?

options.label_zh: 看着朋友,微笑挥手说“你好”
options.label_en: Look at my friend, smile and wave hello
options.outcome_zh: 朋友也笑着和你打招呼,你们开心地一起玩。
options.outcome_en: Your friend smiles and greets you back, and you happily play together.

options.label_zh: 要走时,挥手说“再见,明天见”
options.label_en: When leaving, wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow
options.outcome_zh: 朋友也向你挥手,你们约好明天再玩,心里暖暖的。
options.outcome_en: Your friend waves back, you plan to play again tomorrow, and it feels warm.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 看着对方 → 微笑 → 挥手说你好
visual_cards.caption_en: Look → Smile → Wave and say hello

visual_cards.caption_zh: 打招呼、道别,大家都觉得很友好
visual_cards.caption_en: Greeting and goodbye make everyone feel friendly

visual_cards.title_en: When to greet and say goodbye
visual_cards.caption_zh: 到达时说你好 → 离开时说再见
visual_cards.caption_en: Say hello when I arrive → Say goodbye when I leave

review_zh: 我学会了打招呼和道别:见到朋友,我先看着对方,微笑挥手说“你好”;要走的时候,我挥挥手说“再见,明天见”。朋友也会回应我,大家都很友好。我越来越会和小朋友相处了。
review_en: I learned how to greet and say goodbye: when I see my friend, I look at them, smile, and wave to say hello; when it is time to go, I wave and say goodbye, see you tomorrow. My friend responds too, and we are all friendly. I am getting better at being with friends.
review_flags: 草稿:循证内容,正式使用前需专业人员按孩子的社交与语言水平、真实的问候/告别情境个别化调整。
